source.raw_text: You are to have a code of rules adopted in the Interior Department, and Congress is to have the privilege of revising them ; and those rules are for the leasing and the preserving of mineral springs. I suppose the rules will be in the nature of ordinances which shall inflict fines and punishment if anybody fills a bottle of mineral water from mineral springs without
